chapterTitle: وفاقی بورڈ سالانہ امتحان ماڈل سمیلیٹر ۱ (FBISE Annual Board Simulator Paper 1)

questions.question: Every real number is also a ________ number.
questions.explanation: All real numbers can be represented as complex numbers with an imaginary part equal to zero (x = x + 0i).

questions.question: If z is a complex number, then its mirror image across the real axis in the complex plane is:
questions.explanation: The complex conjugate z̄ = x - iy reflects the point (x, y) across the horizontal real axis to (x, -y).

questions.question: A system of homogeneous linear equations has a non-trivial solution if and only if:
questions.explanation: Homogeneous system AX = O has non-zero solutions if and only if the determinant of matrix A vanishes: |A| = 0.

questions.question: The vector in the direction of i + 2j - 2k having magnitude 12 is:
questions.explanation: Magnitude of given vector is √(1 + 4 + 4) = 3. Unit vector is (i + 2j - 2k)/3. Scaling by 12 gives 12/3 (i + 2j - 2k) = 4(i + 2j - 2k).

If z1 = 3 + 2i and z2 = 5 + 6i, then:

options.D: Inequality cannot be established in complex numbers

questions.explanation: The set of complex numbers C is not an ordered field; inequalities like z1 < z2 are meaningless for complex numbers.

questions.question: If ((1 + i)/(1 - i))^n = 1, then the least positive integral value of n is:
questions.explanation: (1 + i)/(1 - i) = i. Thus i^n = 1, and the smallest positive integer is n = 4.

If A is a square matrix of order n, then |A^t| is equal to:
questions.explanation: The determinant of a matrix and its transpose are always equal: |A^t| = |A|.

If two rows or two columns of a determinant are identical, the value of the determinant is:
questions.explanation: By determinant property, identical parallel lines render the determinant zero.

questions.question: If a · b = 0 and a × b = 0 for non-zero vectors a and b, then:

options.C: At least one of the vectors must be the zero vector

questions.explanation: Two non-zero vectors cannot simultaneously be parallel (cross product 0) and perpendicular (dot product 0).

questions.question: The conjugate of the complex number z = -5i is:
The rank of an identity matrix of order 3 × 3 is:
questions.explanation: All 3 rows of I3 are linearly independent, so rank(I3) = 3.

questions.question: The projection of vector a along vector b is given by:
questions.explanation: Projection of a on b = |a| cos(θ) = (a · b) / |b|.

questions.question: If A is skew-symmetric of odd order (e.g. 3 × 3), then det(A) is:
questions.explanation: det(A^t) = det(-A) = (-1)^n det(A). If n is odd: det(A) = -det(A) => 2 det(A) = 0 => det(A) = 0.

If A is a non-singular matrix, then (A^-1)^-1 is:
questions.explanation: The inverse of an inverse matrix returns the original matrix: (A^-1)^-1 = A.

questions.question: The value of i · (j × k) is:
questions.explanation: j × k = i. Therefore, i · (j × k) = i · i = |i|^2 = 1.
